# Gcore Edge Proxy

> Edge Proxy routes application traffic through the Gcore edge network to filter DDoS attacks and forward clean traffic to origin servers.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/overview.md): Edge Proxy routes application traffic through the Gcore edge network to filter DDoS attacks and forward clean traffic to origin servers.
- [Setup and configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/setup-and-configuration.md): Set up Gcore Edge Proxy protected servers with origin addresses, DDoS filtering profiles, ports, proxy protocol, and deployment steps.
- [Supported applications](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/supported-applications.md): Edge Proxy filtering profiles for game, TCP, and UDP traffic, covering Minecraft, Counter-Strike, FiveM, Rust, and more.
- [Manage Edge Proxy](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/manage-edge-proxy.md): Manage Edge Proxy protected servers by enabling, disabling, editing, deleting, and monitoring traffic and metrics.
- [FAQs and troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-proxy/faqs-and-troubleshooting.md): Find answers to common Edge Proxy questions, DNS migration steps, and troubleshooting fixes for protected IP and origin issues.
